review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.issue: Conditioning calibration on detected double-positive cells selects an expression-enriched population. Count thinning captures sequencing sampling but not all capture/epitope failures or the biological joint distribution. The central excess-disagreement null is not identified by this procedure alone.

An interval including zero is not equivalence to a technical model. A prespecified negligible-effect interval and adequate sensitivity are needed; otherwise the proposed technical conclusion is too strong and the Phase C gate can suppress underpowered real effects.

errors.quote: High RNA+protein− only at low transcript depth
errors.issue: Low RNA depth primarily increases missed RNA calls, producing RNA-negative/protein-positive discordance. It does not by itself explain protein-negative calls among RNA-positive cells; the proposed M1 troubleshooting direction is unsupported without a separately demonstrated protein-depth or correlated-quality mechanism.

errors.quote: Do not claim a stable state
errors.issue: Comparing batch variance with biological-source variance is not a criterion for whether a state exists: a state shared across sources can have little source variance, and large batch effects can coexist with true within-source state structure. An independently validated state contrast and uncertainty are required.

errors.quote: If it does not repeat, the finding is technical.
errors.issue: Nonreplication can reflect sampling, state composition or assay sensitivity. The bridge control diagnoses batch behavior, but one failed repeat does not establish an exclusively technical origin.

errors.quote: Fit the noise and background model on calibration cells only. Freeze it.
errors.issue: No model family, likelihood, normalization, error-propagation rule or parameter-estimation procedure is defined. The biological system, antibody protocol, orthogonal assay and Phase C time grid are also deferred, so the ordered framework is not yet an executable analysis/experiment.

errors.quote: confirmatory claims only for the primary pair list
errors.issue: Prespecifying a list distinguishes confirmatory from exploratory questions but does not itself control multiplicity across that list. No familywise or false-discovery procedure or single-primary hierarchy is given.

rationale: Useful source-level replication, blinding, calibration and explicit technical/temporal/state alternatives. Central null calibration, negative-result interpretation and several troubleshooting rules need correction. Secondary representation candidates lack cell-specific learned modality weights and integrated neighborhoods; held-out external prediction alone does not meet the historical target.
reference_guardrails: Complete final answer, packet, reference and sealed target personally read. Original rubric only; strict-round penalties not active.
Cell-specific learned modality utility and an explicit integrated neighborhood construction are essential for this historical target; generic calibrated weighting or a graph mention is insufficient.
Donor splitting must precede fitted transformations and tuning. Condition blinding does not replace independent endpoint validation or prevent marker-label circularity.

A technical-null mismatch need not define a new cell state. Low-count/QC correlation does not prove artifact. Use known-control calibration, independent phenotypes and quantitative sensitivity analyses.
